items.title: Huang allegations, Berkshire earnings, AI regulations - What’s moving markets
items.summary: Investing.com -- Investors are heading into a busy week with U.S. inflation data and fresh corporate earnings likely to shape market sentiment, while developments at major companies and a potential shift in Washington’s approach to artificial intelligence add to the agenda. Berkshire Hathaway’s latest results highlighted the strength of its cash position despite weaker operating earnings, while Binance announced a finance leadership change days after a major cryptocurrency theft.

items.title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise with Nvidia stock, AI trade in focus
items.summary: All eyes will be on the artificial intelligence trade and Nvidia stock following a volatile post-election shake-up in markets and the revelation that Nvidia's board is opening an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang over his affair.

items.title: FTSE 100 today: Stocks jump as miners lead; oil falls on Iran hopes
items.summary: Investing.com -- British stocks jumped on Monday as miners rose with metals prices and oil slipped on hopes of a U.S.-Iran deal.
